subject: SIG kickoff — MedNova: contact matrix, evidence owners & HIPAA clarifications
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@mednova.com>, security@mednova.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG kickoff — MedNova: contact matrix, evidence owners & HIPAA clarifications

Hi Asha / MedNova security team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can start the SIG/CAIQ flow without rework: 

- High-level ask: MedNova to confirm preferred questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ or your custom vendor doc). If CAIQ is preferred we can prefill to save time.
- SOC 2: we discussed that your SOC 2 is in progress — please confirm whether Type I/II and an estimated availability date.
- HIPAA: please confirm which product paths will require HIPAA BAA coverage (e.g., patient records ingestion vs telemetry). If HIPAA applies, we need to route evidence for controls around PHI handling and our deployment model.
- Data residency & hosting: confirm primary region for customer data (US-East, US-West, EU) and whether any EU residency is required.
- Evidence owners & timeline: name the MedNova contact(s) who will own evidence requests (technical owner, legal/procurement contact) and a target completion date for the questionnaire.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short Redwood SOC2 summary and a CAIQ prefill template to demonstrate the format we typically use. If you prefer, we can also send a link to a completed example.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm preferred questionnaire and provide contact matrix (technical, security, procurement).
2) We send a prefill + evidence checklist; you map owners and return by target date (suggest 2 weeks).
3) We schedule a 30 min evidence walk-through with your technical owner.

If you’d like us to complete your custom vendor questionnaire instead, please attach it and we’ll prefill the answers we can.

Thanks — I’ll leave Karthik and Soojin on copy for technical clarifications and evidence routing.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0143

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, redwood_caaiq_prefill.xlsx
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@mednova.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: security@mednova.com, procurement@mednova.com
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — MedNova: contact matrix, evidence owners & HIPAA clarifications

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Questionnaire preference: we generally prefer CAIQ + a short custom vendor questionnaire for procurement items. Please go ahead and prefill the CAIQ; we will attach our procurement doc as needed.
- SOC 2: we are targeting SOC 2 Type II; interim report expected 2028-11-10 (internal target). We can share the SOC2 Type II report once available, but we do have a security attestation from earlier that should answer many controls questions.
- HIPAA: yes — PHI will be in scope for the clinical ingestion path (Patient Ingest API). For now, scope HIPAA controls to the Patient Ingest API and related storage buckets. We will need BAA language passed to legal.
- Data residency: primary residency US (US-East preferred). No EU residency requirement for this initial engagement.
- Contacts:
  - Technical owner (evidence): Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@mednova.com> (cc’d on this thread)
  - Security contact: security@mednova.com
  - Procurement: procurement@mednova.com

We’ve attached our vendor questionnaire template to this reply (mednova_vendor_questionnaire.docx). Could you prefill CAIQ and also do a first pass on our vendor doc? Procurement would like a 3-week turnaround if possible; technically we can be faster but legal may add time.

Thanks,
Asha
Director, Product Integrations | MedNova Health
asha.patel@mednova.com

Attachment: mednova_vendor_questionnaire.docx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@mednova.com>, Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@mednova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, procurement@mednova.com
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — MedNova: contact matrix, evidence owners & HIPAA clarifications

Thanks Asha — that helps a lot. A couple follow-ups and notes from our side: 

- We’ll prefill CAIQ and return the file within 4 business days. Attached is a short Redwood SOC2 summary (redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf) and a sample CAIQ prefill template; we’ll produce a completed CAIQ for Ravi to review.
- HIPAA / BAA: understood — we’ll flag BAA language and loop Legal once MedNova confirms the final scope. For the prefill, we will tag any controls that relate specifically to PHI handling so legal can review only the PHI-relevant docs.
- Evidence walk-through: Karthik (copied) will lead the technical walk-through with Ravi. Proposed slot: Thu 2028-09-20 10:00am PT (30 mins). Ravi, can you confirm? If not, suggest alternatives.
- Data residency: we’ll note US-East as primary. If that changes we can re-route evidence where needed.
- Timeline: our recommended cadence is prefill returned in 4 business days -> 1 week for MedNova to map owners & collect evidence -> walk-through -> final pass for procurement/legal. That should fit within procurement’s 3-week ask unless legal requires more time.

I’ve included a link to the SOC2 summary in case your procurement/legal wants to view before the full report: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-summary

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 18 Sep 2028 at 10:35 AM Asha Patel <asha.patel@mednova.com> wrote:
> > Questionnaire preference: CAIQ + custom procurement doc.
> > SOC2: targeting Type II, interim 2028-11-10.
> > HIPAA: Patient Ingest API in scope for PHI.

Neha
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, redwood_caaiq_prefill.xlsx
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@mednova.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@mednova.com>, security@mednova.com, procurement@mednova.com
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — MedNova: contact matrix, evidence owners & HIPAA clarifications

Thanks Neha — confirmed on the proposed plan. Ravi is available for Thu 09/20 10am PT; he’ll lead technical evidence mapping. Procurement noted the 3-week window and will flag any contract/legal blockers early.

A quick ask from Legal: can you include a short DPIA note if we end up processing PHI in the EU for future phases? Not urgent for this kickoff but would be helpful to have a short template.

We’ll review the CAIQ prefill once received. Look forward to the walk-through.

Best,
Asha
summary: Post-demo SIG initiation for MedNova. CAIQ preferred; SOC2 Type II in progress (expected 2028-11-10). HIPAA applies to Patient Ingest API; primary data residency US-East. Technical evidence owner Ravi Kumar confirmed. Redwood to prefill CAIQ (4 business days) and provide SOC2 summary; technical walk-through scheduled 2028-09-20 10:00 PT. Procurement target 3-week turnaround. Legal asked for DPIA template for future EU PHI scenarios.
